request.instruction:
You review a prior-authorization request against a medical policy's criteria.
For each criterion, decide from the evidence alone whether it is:
- "met": the evidence states that the criterion is satisfied,
- "not-met": the evidence states something that fails the criterion,
- "insufficient": the evidence does not say, or says it only vaguely, without a date, or as hearsay.
Cite every evidence reference you relied on, exactly as given (for example "DocumentReference/doc-1").
Never cite a reference that is not in the evidence list. Do not recommend an outcome.
Respond with JSON only:
{"findings": [{"criterionId": "...", "status": "met" | "not-met" | "insufficient", "evidence": ["..."], "rationale": "..."}]}

criteria.title: Obstructive sleep apnea is diagnosed
criteria.requirement: The member has a diagnosis of obstructive sleep apnea, recorded as a condition or stated by the prescriber.

criteria.title: Apnea-hypopnea index of 18 or more
criteria.requirement: A sleep study dated within the 12 months before the request reports an apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) of at least 18 events per hour.

criteria.title: A conservative measure was tried first
criteria.requirement: The record documents at least 21 days of positional therapy or a weight-management programme that did not resolve the symptoms.

criteria.title: Signed order with a pressure setting
criteria.requirement: A signed prescriber order names the device and its pressure setting or pressure range.

evidence.text: Condition: G47.33 Obstructive sleep apnea (adult) (pediatric). Onset 2026-07-02.

Clinical note (Sleep study report, dated 2026-07-01T12:00:00Z):
In-lab polysomnography, 2026-07-01.
Total sleep time 6.1 hours. Apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) 31 events per hour.
Lowest oxygen saturation 82 percent.
Impression: obstructive sleep apnea.

Clinical note (Prescriber follow-up note, dated 2026-09-10T12:00:00Z):
Follow-up for obstructive sleep apnea.
Positional therapy with a positional belt from 2026-07-10 to 2026-08-14, 35 days.
Snoring and daytime sleepiness persisted; Epworth score 15.
Order: CPAP device, auto-titrating, pressure range 6 to 14 cm H2O, heated humidifier.
Order signed electronically by the prescriber on 2026-09-10.

value.rationale: The member has a recorded condition of obstructive sleep apnea.
The sleep study dated 2026-07-01 (within the 12 months before the request) reports an AHI of 31 events per hour, which is at least 18.
The record documents positional therapy from 2026-07-10 to 2026-08-14 (35 days), which is at least 21 days, and symptoms persisted.
A signed prescriber order names the CPAP device and a pressure range of 6 to 14 cm H2O.
